definition.description: Visits seen within 30 minutes per 100 visits: the same figure as Seen Within Target % on a 0-100 scale. Used where a table ranks by it next to the percentage column (a table column format applies to every column of the same measure).
Average satisfaction score (1-10), identical to Avg Satisfaction; a separate item so a table can rank by it beside the score column.
Patient self-reported race with labels short enough for chart axes (Native American/Alaska Native shortened).

preparedTarget: How does each time band perform against the 30-minute target?

change.name: How does each time band perform against the 30-minute target?

definition.question: How does each time band perform against the 30-minute target?
definition.description: Each three-hour arrival band: visits, visits over 30 minutes and their share of all over-target visits, share seen within 30 minutes and its rank (1 = worst), average wait, with the monthly trend of the share seen within 30 minutes.

preparedTarget: How does each department perform against the 30-minute target?

change.name: How does each department perform against the 30-minute target?

definition.question: How does each department perform against the 30-minute target?
definition.description: Each referral department: visits, visits over 30 minutes and their share of all over-target visits, share seen within 30 minutes and its rank (1 = worst), average wait and satisfaction, with the monthly trend of the share seen within 30 minutes.

preparedTarget: Do some patient groups by race wait longer than others?

change.name: Do some patient groups by race wait longer than others?

definition.question: Do some patient groups by race wait longer than others?
definition.description: Share of visits seen within 30 minutes by self-reported race, worst first.

preparedTarget: Do women, men and non-conforming patients wait alike?

change.name: Do women, men and non-conforming patients wait alike?

definition.question: Do women, men and non-conforming patients wait alike?
definition.description: Share of visits seen within 30 minutes by gender. Non-Conforming covers only 24 visits.

preparedTarget: Which departments' patients are least satisfied, and how long did they wait?

change.name: Which departments' patients are least satisfied, and how long did they wait?

definition.question: Which departments' patients are least satisfied, and how long did they wait?
definition.description: Each referral department: average satisfaction and its rank (1 = least satisfied), scores recorded, average wait and share seen within 30 minutes, with the monthly satisfaction trend.
